title: Senate passes new electoral reform bill after marathon session
excerpt: Lawmakers voted 78-12 in favour of amendments targeting diaspora voting and result transmission.
body: The Senate on Thursday passed the long-awaited Electoral Act Amendment Bill, clearing a path for diaspora Nigerians to vote in future elections and setting stricter deadlines for result transmission.
author: Ada Okafor

title: Super Eagles name squad for World Cup qualifiers
excerpt: Coach announces 24-man squad ahead of next month's decisive qualifying matches.
body: The Super Eagles technical crew has released the list of players invited for the upcoming World Cup qualifiers, with three uncapped players making the cut for the first time.
author: Tunde Bakare

title: Flood alert issued for coastal states as rains intensify
excerpt: Meteorological agency warns residents in low-lying areas to relocate temporarily.
body: The Nigerian Meteorological Agency has issued a red alert for several coastal states as intensifying rainfall raises the risk of flash flooding over the next 72 hours.
author: Grace Effiong

title: Sprinter breaks 20-year national record in Lagos
excerpt: The 23-year-old shaved two-tenths of a second off the previous mark.
body: A crowd at the National Stadium watched the young sprinter cross the line in a record-breaking time, ending a 20-year wait for a new national best.
author: Tunde Bakare

title: Local derby ends in dramatic late equaliser
excerpt: A stoppage-time header kept the points shared in front of a packed stadium.
body: The much-awaited derby ended level after a header in the 93rd minute cancelled out what looked like a winning goal for the home side.
author: Tunde Bakare

title: D'Tigers finalise roster ahead of AfroBasket
excerpt: Coach cuts the squad to 12 after a week-long training camp.
body: The national basketball team has announced its final 12-man roster for the upcoming continental tournament following a competitive training camp.
author: Ife Adeyemi

title: Health ministry launches free malaria screening drive
excerpt: Mobile clinics will visit 200 communities over the next six weeks.
body: The Federal Ministry of Health has begun a nationwide malaria screening programme, offering free tests and treatment at mobile clinics in underserved communities.
author: Grace Effiong

title: Naira firms against dollar as CBN unveils new forex policy
excerpt: Analysts say the new rules could narrow the gap between official and parallel rates.
body: The Central Bank of Nigeria has announced changes to foreign exchange rules, a move that helped the naira gain ground against the dollar in early trading.
author: Ada Okafor

title: Lagos commuters face delays as rail repairs begin
excerpt: Authorities advise alternative routes during the two-week repair window.
body: Commuters on the busiest rail corridor in Lagos should expect longer travel times as engineers begin scheduled repairs on a damaged stretch of track.
author: Grace Effiong
